summary_1line: Hanuman reveals his colossal form to Bhima, explains why he let Rama slay Ravana, and instructs Bhima on duty, humility, and proper conduct.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman expands into a mountain-like form towering over the plantain grove while Bhima stands awestruck with hair bristling.
The gigantic Hanuman, copper-eyed and fanged, stretches across the forest with his long tail lashing as Bhima closes his eyes before the blazing sight.
Hanuman gently addressing Bhima after shrinking his form, the two wind-born brothers facing each other in the forest.
